help: S0 bedroom opening, played top to bottom. Each step can use any of these keys:
pose: Mina's picture in bed (art key). Poses cross-fade.
say: a key from dialogue.json shown in the narration box; waits until it is read (click/Space skips). "" hides the box.
wait: seconds to stay on this step.
insert: full-screen close-up, "hands" or "pills" (stays while the next steps use the same insert).
show / hide: nightstand props (prop_book, prop_phone, prop_pill_bottle, prop_water_glass).
sfx: one-shot sound; its volume is audio.<name>_db in balance.json. clock_db: change the clock volume.
heart: true/false starts or fades the heartbeat. tremble: shaky hands. glow: phone light on her face.
sleep: true starts falling asleep: eyes close, the music-box intro begins, and the dream follows.
